fact: Current image hosting provider for nomads-tour-site (2026-02-02 16:32 UTC): Stores images in 'nomads-asia-tours' folder. Uses CldUploadWidget for uploads, CldImage component for display with automatic blur placeholders. Backend handled by convex/cloudinaryActions.ts with signed URLs, deletion, and metadata operations. Migration planned to Cloudflare R2 for cost reduction.

Migration driver: Cost and bandwidth limitations (2026-02-02 16:35 UTC): Current Cloudinary pricing uses credit system (25 credits shared across storage, bandwidth, transformations). For image-heavy tour site targeting Asia travelers, bandwidth costs will scale significantly. Cloudflare R2 offers unlimited free egress vs Cloudinary's metered credits, making it more cost-effective at scale.
